item.title: Charters charged by FICAC
item.description: Former Journalist Charlie Charters has been formally charged by the Fiji Independent Commission against Corruption. He has been charged with two counts of aiding and abetting an unknown person in FICAC. He is expected to be produced in court this afternoon Stay with us for more developments.
